Use ordinary survival actions and no village supplies, supplied iron, supplied tools, or operator commands. Choose a surveyed stable site for a modest 5 by 5 outer footprint, supported floor, two-block-high walls, complete roof, a wooden door in a two-cell entrance, and a clear 3 by 3 interior. Prioritize hazard recovery and useful partial work. Do not restart completed material work after a changed method.
